_about: Essences from the DM primer. Add your own by copying an entry. traits: the small perk each essence grants (skill/tool proficiency or a cantrip). stoneSpells: spells an awakening stone of this essence can grant, by spell level 1-5. manifest: how the essence shows on its user.

essences.name: Dark
manifest: shadow wisps trailing every strike
eyes that swallow lamplight
a shadow that moves a heartbeat late
a faint chill and dimmer light around them

essences.name: Blood
manifest: crimson mist when they bleed
veins that glow red when they fight
a metallic scent in the air
wounds that close a little too quickly

essences.name: Sin
manifest: a voice that makes people recall their regrets
black veins spreading from their touch
whispers only the guilty hear
an aura that makes animals uneasy

essences.name: Fire
manifest: a blade that glows like a forge
embers drifting from their hair
skin warm to the touch
heat shimmer when they are angry

essences.name: Water
manifest: droplets beading on their skin in dry air
movements that flow like a current
eyes the colour of deep water
the sound of rain when they cast

essences.name: Earth
manifest: skin with a faint granite grain
footsteps that sound heavier than they should
dust that settles when they stand still
small stones that roll toward them

essences.name: Wind
manifest: a breeze that follows them indoors
hair and cloak always in motion
the smell of rain before a storm
a faint whistle when they move fast

essences.name: Light
manifest: a soft glow under the skin
a halo of motes when they heal
shadows that recoil from them
eyes like polished gold

essences.name: Magic
manifest: blue-white motes orbiting their hands
a hum that sensitive people can feel
runes that flicker across their skin
enchanted items reacting when they pass

essences.name: Swift
manifest: afterimages when they dodge
restless, quick hands
a blur at the edge of vision
never seeming to be out of breath

essences.name: Might
manifest: blows that land with a thunderclap
a frame that seems to take up more room
cracked stone where they plant their feet
a grip that dents metal
